## Objective
- Build a complete, playable game inspired by “Ever feature in gta 6” (interpreted as a Vice City-style open-city sandbox).

## Requirements
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Deliver a playable game, with responsive touch controls.
- For visual checks, save small JPEG screenshots and inspect only the latest.

## Decisions
- Built an original 2D overhead game titled “Vice City: After Hours,” with a neon Vice City aesthetic and no GTA assets.
- Added open-city exploration, driving, missions, collectibles, police pursuit, health, cash, minimap, and keyboard/touch controls.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented the game in `index.html`.
- Verified script syntax with Node.
- Ran the game in Playwright and inspected desktop and mobile screenshots.
- Confirmed no browser console errors after adding an inline favicon.

2. Reload the page, inspect a fresh mobile JPEG screenshot, and check the browser console.
3. Briefly report the interpretation and controls when finished.

- `index.html`: Contains the complete game implementation and responsive UI.

- Local dev server was started with `python3 -m http.server 3002`; URL is `http://localhost:3002`.
